EOG Resources, Inc. Provides Production Guidance for the Year Full Year 2019; Reports Impairment Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2019; Reports Production Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2019. EOG Resources, Inc. provided production guidance for the year full year 2019. The company expects exceeded crude oil production target range and raised full-year 2019 U.S. crude oil growth target from 14% to 15%.For the third quarter, the company reported impairments of $105,275,000 against $44,617,000 a year ago.For the third quarter, the company reported total natural gas liquids volumes of 141.3 MBbld against 127.8 MBbld a year ago. Natural Gas Volumes of 1,373 MMcfd against 1,236 MMcfd a year ago. Crude Oil Equivalent Volumes of 834.2 MBoed against 748.8 MBoed a year ago. Total production volumes of 76.7 MMBoe against 68.9 MMBoe a year ago. For the nine months, the company reported total natural gas liquids volumes of 130.8 MBbld against 113.9 MBbld a year ago. Natural Gas Volumes of 1,346 MMcfd against 1,214 MMcfd a year ago. Crude Oil Equivalent Volumes of 807.1 MBoed against 704.0 MBoed a year ago. Total production volumes of 220.3 MMBoe against 192.2 MMBoe a year ago.
